# GSAP runtime

This directory contains the browser builds of GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger 3.15.0 from the official `gsap` npm package. The version is pinned so the static site does not depend on a third-party CDN at runtime.

- Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap
- License: https://gsap.com/standard-license
